items.title: Betty Lee Hanson, Joe James, George Lewis, Joe Lewis, Joe Butler, Kid Thomas Valentine, Bill Russell, Allan…
items.q: Connelly and Ramport came from playing in Kenner. He drank some of that old bad, overnight liquor, and killed him.

ctx.x: Who gave you the money to buy the trumpet? Did you earn it?

No, my daddy. You see, my daddy, he used to play in the brass band. And he used to have rehearsal there, you know, at the house sometimes. But, you know, we used to go from house to house. Well, they would leave all the instruments there. Well, we all decided what instruments we would like to learn. See, first, I used to play with the trumpet, play the trombone, and all, you know what I mean? The sliding trombone and the key trombone, you know what I mean? So, well, a fella, another boy was playing with us. Well,…
No kidding, he died like that?
